record_type_quote: Our main study was conducted on a nationally representative sample of 737 White adults.11 In addition to the main study, we also conducted a pretest and a replication to examine alternative explanations for the results.
reasoning: The paper develops and tests an original account of the interaction of candidate race, campaign negativity, and racial attitudes. Its replication study repeats its own main study within this same article, with changed racial-attitude measures and timing. Prior studies provide background, predictions, measures, and experimental procedures; no specific earlier published finding is the replication target.
